desc: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015, we hereby inform that the Company has received a communication dated August 25, 2026 from BSE Limited (BSE) in relation to levy of fine for Non-compliance with Regulation 19(1)/19(2) of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 for the Quarter ended June 30, 2026.
